annotations.title: Save a design as a theme

description: Save a design to QRdx as a saved theme, listed under Themes in the dashboard and offered in the editor. Needs a QRdx API key with full access on this MCP connection (Authorization: Bearer qrdx_…). It saves to the key's workspace: your own themes, or a team's shared themes (owners and admins, on plans with team themes). Counts against the plan's saved-theme limit (10 on Free). Pass design_qr's qrdxStyle as style.

name.description: The theme's name, up to 50 characters

style.description: The design: the qrdxStyle that design_qr returns (logoIcon and logoFileId included)
